roll.title: Roll a six to start
roll.text: Roll a six to bring a piece out of your yard. Every six earns you another roll.

race.title: Race your pieces home
race.text: Move clockwise around the board, then up your own coloured lane. You need an exact roll to finish.

capture.title: Capture, or stay safe
capture.text: Land on a rival to send them back to their yard. Star and entry squares are safe, and a capture earns a bonus roll.

modes.title: Play your way
modes.text: Take on the computer offline, pass one phone around with friends, or go online for quick matches. Sign in to keep your coins and progress.
